title: 第17章 迷雾又临恶虎山寨第18章 杀入山寨青铜宝箱
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: 出来狩猎已经有不少时间了，找到山贼可比杀山贼难多了。
期间，吴语化身大胃袋，一边猛猛吃“精致食物”，一边将普通小石子印刻为【毕方符印】的道具。
“太撑了，正好迷雾要来......休息一下！”
他长呼一口气，靠在一块大石头边上，眺望远处。
出来猎杀山贼，吴语自然不会进入即将被迷雾覆盖的区域，此刻的位置就在内圈安全区。
很快，倒计时结束！
晴朗的天空被黑压压的云雾笼罩，灰色的迷雾在山间弥漫开来，以肉眼可见的速度变得浓郁。
不一会儿，灰雾便浓厚无比，难以看清里边的景象了。
但神奇的是，这些灰色迷雾犹如被一条分割线阻住了，将山林一分为二，一丝一缕都没有越过。
“这迷雾，恐怕只有登塔者会遇到。”
吴语面色凝重。
不管怎么看，这“迷雾”都十分危险！
一则，【地图】之前面板提示了迷雾会有伤害，哪怕说【新人秘境】的迷雾伤害会减少百分之八十。
二则，既然存在撤离点，那说明神秘高塔并不鼓励登塔者逗留此地！那么，迷雾便是驱赶...甚至是杀死登塔者的手段！
“无论这是不是一个游戏，亦或者神仙的玩笑。”
“我都不能拿自己的性命冒险。”
吴语心头微动，拿出了青铜凭证。
打开【地图】一看，灰色的迷雾果然覆盖了大片区域。
只有内圈还算安全，而迷雾的倒计时也刷新了！
迷雾降临：23小时59分钟32秒。
“也是一天时间。”
“24小时也够了，只是无法和柳争一起撤离。”
吴语微微沉吟。
论安全，和柳争等人一同离开自然是最好的，有官方巡查在，而且还是一个身上一大堆科技装备的二代，什么山贼村民一枪一个，甚至超凡武者都能打死！
但......那样收益也是最低的，
吴语出都出来了，自然不可能只打六个小时就回去。
片刻，他起身灵活的从山石后跃出，继续赶路。
距离恶虎山寨...已经不远了！
两个小时后！
吴语爬上一棵大树，望向林间小道的尽头。
那是一个简陋的寨子，木质的大门和箭塔，还有一些懒懒散散的兽皮衣壮汉在守卫。
其中有弓手，也有砍刀手。
“恶虎山寨正常情况下就几百人，而且大半人都会待在外边巡逻，抢劫，献祭等等！待在山寨中的，一般情况不到百人，只不过大当家会在里边！”
吴语眯起眼观察了好一会儿，心中一松。
知己知彼，方能百战百胜！
一切和他调查来的信息一样，恶虎山寨内部的人并不多。
甚至可能是因为柳争大开杀戒的关系，山寨中山贼的人数看起来都没有百人了。
“看不到老弱病残......难道都被拿去献祭了？”
观察许久，吴语发现了关键点。
恶虎山寨可是会山君仪轨的，通过献祭成为“伥鬼”，得到山君赐福！
但那山君已经被城里的超凡武者打伤，这会儿估摸着是顾及不到山寨这边的。
毕竟，山君自己都躲到迷途洞里边去了！
“小心为上！弄出一点动静试试......”
content_en:
It has been a long time since I went out hunting, and it is much harder to find the bandits than to kill them.
During this period, Wu Yu transformed into a big stomach bag and ate "delicate food" fiercely while engraving ordinary pebbles as props for the "Bifang Sigil".
"I'm so exhausted, the mist is coming... take a rest!"
He took a long breath, leaned against a big rock, and looked into the distance.
When Wu Yu came out to hunt bandits, he would naturally not enter the area that was about to be covered by fog. His current location was in the inner safe zone.
Soon, the countdown is over!
The clear sky was shrouded in black clouds and mist, and the gray mist spread across the mountains, becoming thicker at a speed visible to the naked eye.
After a while, the gray fog became so thick that it was difficult to see clearly the scene inside.
But the magical thing is that these gray fogs seem to be blocked by a dividing line, dividing the mountain forest into two, without even a trace crossing.
"I'm afraid only those who climb the tower will encounter this fog."
Wu Yu looked solemn.
No matter how you look at it, this "fog" is very dangerous!
For one thing, the previous panel of [Map] indicated that fog would cause damage, even though the damage of fog in [Newcomer Secret Realm] would be reduced by 80%.
Secondly, since there is an evacuation point, it means that the mysterious tower does not encourage climbers to stay here! Then, the mist is the means to drive away...or even kill those who climb the tower!
"Whether this is a game or a joke from the gods."
"I can't even risk my life."
Wu Yu's heart moved slightly and he took out the bronze certificate.
When I opened the [Map], I saw that gray fog indeed covered a large area.
Only the inner circle is still safe, and the countdown of the fog has been refreshed!
The fog fell: 23 hours, 59 minutes and 32 seconds.
"It's also a day."
"24 hours is enough, but I can't evacuate with Liu Zheng."
Wu Yu pondered slightly.
In terms of safety, it is naturally best to leave with Liu Zheng and others. There are official patrols, and he is also a second-generation man with a lot of technological equipment. He can kill any bandits, villagers, or even extraordinary warriors with one shot!
But...that way the benefits are also the lowest,
Wu Yu had already come out, so it was naturally impossible for him to go back after just six hours of fighting.
After a moment, he stood up and jumped out from behind the rocks and continued on his way.
It's not far from Evil Tiger Village...!
...
Two hours later!
Wu Yu climbed up a big tree and looked at the end of the forest path.
It was a simple village with a wooden gate and arrow tower, and some lazy strong men in animal skins were guarding it.
Among them are archers and machetes.
"Evil Tiger Village has a few hundred people under normal circumstances, and most of them will stay outside to patrol, rob, sacrifice, etc. There are usually less than a hundred people staying in the village, but the boss will be inside!"
Wu Yu narrowed his eyes and observed for a while, feeling relieved.
Only by knowing yourself and the enemy can you be victorious in every battle!
Everything was consistent with the information he had investigated, there were not many people inside the Evil Tiger Village.
It may even be because of Liu Zheng's killing spree, the number of bandits in the village seems to be less than a hundred.
"You can't see the old, the weak, the sick...could they all be sacrificed?"
After observing for a long time, Wu Yu discovered the key point.
The Evil Tiger Village is acquainted with the tiger's rituals. By making sacrifices, one becomes a "ghost" and receives the tiger's blessing!
But the tiger had been injured by the extraordinary warriors in the city, and he probably couldn't take care of the village at the moment.
After all, the tiger himself hid in the Lost Cave!
"Be careful! Try to make some noise..."
title_en: Chapter 17 The fog comes again to the Evil Tiger Village Chapter 18 Breaking into the mountain village’s bronze treasure chest
